headline: Reports say the White House is preparing sweeping new tariffs on China, the EU and dozens of other countries, and stocks fell on the news
points: The Wall Street Journal reported that the White House is preparing broad new tariffs on China, the EU, Japan, South Korea and dozens of other countries, with details possibly announced this week
Final rates have not been announced. The EU, Japan and South Korea are expected to be capped at 15 percent or lower, with China facing the steepest rates
Tech stocks led the fall, as Monday's big Nvidia-driven rally faded
Wednesday brings the PCE inflation report, a second estimate of economic growth and the Fed's Beige Book, then US markets close on Thursday for Thanksgiving
sources: Investing.com, citing the Wall Street Journal, 24 Nov 2026: https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/white-house-prepares-sweeping-new-tariffs-on-china-eu-and-dozens-of-nations-5048285
note: Intraday facts: the tariff plan is a media report (WSJ via Investing.com), not an announcement; do not state rates. Re-check the S&P 500 close before the final build.
